title: Squared Crosshair
description: Changes Crosshair to Square. Very Aesthetic.
body:
# 🟩 Squared Crosshair (1.21.1) #

A clean, minimalist resource pack that replaces the default Minecraft crosshair with sharp, pixel-perfect square alternative. Say goodbye to the uneven default cross!

---

## ✨ Features ##

* **Centered In-Game Crosshair:** The default crosshair is transformed into an aligned square for better aiming and block placement.
* **Vanilla Friendly:** Designed to fit perfectly with the game's default art style.
* **Version Compatibility:** Officially built for **1.21.1**

---
**Created with ❤️ for the pixel-art community.**

_See the Example in Gallery_
